title: Audit 11: load the final-message rule once, from its hook (dotfiles)
notes:
In dotfiles: rules/final-message.md reaches a session twice, from the UserPromptSubmit hook and from the rules/ folder. Move the file out of rules/ and point the hook at it.

From the CLAUDE.md audit, docs/workflow/claude-md-audit.md (card fad098f2). The rule stays in CLAUDE.md until card 13 deletes it.

comments.body: dotfiles PR #72 (naeemba/dotfiles), ready to merge, not merged. final-message.md moved from claude/rules/ to claude/hooks/; the UserPromptSubmit hook reads ~/.claude/hooks/final-message.md; install.sh links claude/hooks; install.test.sh checks the link and the file (passes). Subagents no longer get the rule from rules/ (their last message goes to the calling agent, not a person). After merge: pull the dotfiles checkout and re-run ./install.sh, or the hook prints the heading with no rule. Dotfiles has no CI. Review loop: floor-addressed, 1 round, 1 low fixed (db28ab4), 1 nit rejected (rename hooks/).
